faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 5.0 V8 petrol engine in the Land Rover Discovery 4. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a supercharged Range Rover V8 replace my Discovery 4 508PN?
faqs.a: Not directly. Supercharged and naturally aspirated 5.0 V8 engines differ in components, ancillaries and calibration, so we check your VIN, engine code and market specification before recommending a compatible replacement.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 508PN engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 4 V8 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the Discovery 4 engine replacement cost for a 508PN?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and the labour involved, including body lifting. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 508PN engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover V8 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 508PN engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your Discovery V8?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 4 guide the decision. Coil, water pump, coolant pipe and gasket faults can usually be repaired individually. If timing chain failure or severe overheating has damaged the engine, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 4 508PN engine replacement is often more practical.
paragraphs: A large V8 depends on a healthy cooling system and clean oil, and body-lift access makes it sensible to check related parts. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, coolant pipes and thermostat, check the ignition system and gearbox, and renew all fluids.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 4 V8 Problems
engineProblems.description: The 5.0 V8 usually gives warning signs early, and prompt checks can prevent serious internal damage.

cards.title: Early Timing Guide Wear
cards.description: A rattle at start-up, timing correlation codes or rough running can indicate worn timing chain guides or tensioners, a known issue on earlier 5.0 V8s. We inspect the guides, tensioners and chains.

cards.title: Water Pump Weeping
cards.description: Coolant traces at the front of the engine, a falling level or rising temperature may point to a leaking or failing water pump. We check pump condition and cooling performance.

cards.title: Coolant Pipe and Thermostat Leaks
cards.description: A sweet smell, damp patches or coolant loss can come from ageing coolant pipes, the thermostat housing or perished hoses. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Direct-Injection Carbon Deposits
cards.description: Rough idle, hesitation or misfire codes on higher-mileage engines may be linked to carbon building up on the intake valves. We assess running quality and intake condition.

cards.title: Coil-on-Plug Misfires
cards.description: Juddering, a flashing engine light or poor acceleration are often caused by worn spark plugs or failing ignition coils. We test the ignition system cylinder by cylinder.

cards.title: Valve Cover Gasket Seepage
cards.description: Oil seeping onto hot components, burning smells or light smoke may come from hardened valve cover gaskets or ageing engine seals. We locate the leak and inspect the seals.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 4 508PN Engine: Your Complete 5.0 V8 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 4 508PN engine is the naturally aspirated 5.0-litre V8 petrol fitted to early Discovery 4 models in certain markets. Strong and smooth, it is now ageing, and timing chain guide wear, water pump leaks, carbon deposits and misfires often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

This Land Rover Discovery V8 engine belongs to the same family as other Range Rover V8 engines, including supercharged versions, but output, ancillaries and wiring differ. We identify the correct engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 4 508PN engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
